title: Figure 18. Design of DNA origami; Figure 19. Several DNA origami folding paths
description: Figure 18 shows four design steps: (a) "Fill the shape with helices and a periodic array of crossovers," (b) "Raster fill helices with a single long scaffold strand," (c) "Add helper strands to bind the scaffold together," and (d) "A helical representation of the structure," with labels such as "1 nm inter-helix gap" and "seam." Figure 19 shows line drawings of star, smiley-face, and triangle folding paths above rainbow-colored versions of the same shapes on black backgrounds. Captions read "Figure 18. Design of DNA origami. (112)" and "Figure 19. Several DNA origami folding paths. (112)."
